what: the bar a surrogate must beat and the rate verified labels can be made, measured on the solver before any model is written
gate_s4: surrogate error at the 95th percentile inside the S1 error bar on held-out packages; guided search scores at least 5x fewer layouts and returns the identical optimum; the copilot cannot state a temperature not in a solve record

bar.definition: per design, the combined band (mesh, materials, boundary in quadrature) the app prints beside the peak -- confirmed against measured silicon by tools/ttc_crossvalidate.py (boundary term 5.5 % predicted, 5.3 % RMS measured)
bar.note: a label whose peak is flagged as a lower bound (hotspot finer than the mesh) must be excluded from training or carried with its flag

labels.escalation: a label flagged as a lower bound is re-solved at the fine mesh

split.why: the S4 gate says held-out PACKAGES; a model that has seen the package has seen most of the answer
